info.background_text:
Embracing Shield
Although she almost always wears an absentminded expression,she is clear about her likes and dislikes and utilizes everything at her disposal if the situation involves her friends. She enjoys taking care of others and usually starts things off with a hug when she sees anyone who is struggling.
